output.headline: Nordic Capital has an open platform in the target's own sub-sector, a provider-focused record, and the capacity to pay near the upper quartile.
output.differentiator: Brings an open platform in the target's own sub-sector for an add-on route, with 22 of 24 deals in provider services and a EUR 9 billion Fund XI. [A:angles, P:2]
output.why_them: Add-on to its open sub-sector platform; provider specialist

acquirer_overview.title: Provider-focused sponsor with a well-funded, healthcare-committed platform
points: Financial sponsor with 24 deals from 2016 to 2024; 21 of 24 (88%) closed and 22 of 24 (92%) were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Healthcare is one of four core industries; Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion). [P:1, P:2]
Ranks 2 on the priority list of 10 and 3 overall among 107 buyers scored, with a likelihood of 4.8%. [R:rank]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An open platform in the sub-sector makes this a natural add-on
points: Four deals in the target's own sub-sector and 18 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; 22 of 24 deals are provider services. [T:record, A:angles]
Platform Build is a motive in 7 of 24 deals, consistent with adding the target to its open platform. [M:platform_build, A:angles]
Sub-sector relevance and deal count are modest factors for. Region is a slight factor against, though it has 2 Midwest deals. [S:sector_rel, S:activity, S:geo_fit, T:record]

precedent_activity.title: Same-sub-sector and Midwest deals frame how it prices
points: 2024 carve-out of Harbor Health Network, $35M, in the target's own sub-sector, at 11.6x EV/EBITDA. [D:MA-2024-0339]
Leveraged buyouts in the same sub-sector: Harbor Medical Center, 2023, $991M, 11.1x; Green Medical Center, 2022, $1,304M, 15.0x. [D:MA-2023-0466, D:MA-2022-0045]
2024 recapitalization of Principal Physician Group, a Midwest physician group, $76M, at 15.9x. [D:MA-2024-0431]

valuation_context.title: 75th percentile is defensible; returns work with a platform exit
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th. The target's 16.8% margin versus a 12.9% comps median supports the 75th. [V:comps]
Its median paid is 12.5x, but it paid 15.9x and 15.0x on recent deals, showing room to stretch. [V:comps, D:MA-2024-0431, D:MA-2022-0045]
Capacity: 5.0x leverage, $128M equity cheque, 18.7% IRR at ask versus a 20% target. Maximum price is $193M at the same exit, $216M at a 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $77M is under half the target's $200M EV.
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 of 24 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band; its largest was $1,304M.
risk_flags.reality: Scale is not a barrier on its record, but this is below its usual range. [T:record, K:size_band]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask is 18.7%, below its 20% target.
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x supports a maximum price of $216M.
risk_flags.reality: Works only if it underwrites the add-on exit, not a same-multiple exit capped at $193M. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Limited regional footprint
risk_flags.concern: Prior buying in the target's region is a slight factor against.
risk_flags.mitigant: Two Midwest deals, including Principal Physician Group in 2024.
risk_flags.reality: Top regions are Mountain West, Great Plains and West Coast; Midwest is thinner. [S:geo_fit, T:record, D:MA-2024-0431]

conviction.rationale: Rests on 4 own-sub-sector and 18 adjacent provider deals, an open platform for an add-on route, and a place among the 3 highest-scored buyers (#2). Against: its $77M median deal is under half the $200M EV. [C:conviction]
